description:
As a user
  I want to mark todos as complete or incomplete
  So that I can track my progress

elements.name: Mark a single todo as complete

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
the todo "Buy groceries" should be marked as completed
the todo count should show "2 items left"
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I should see 2 completed todos
the todo count should show "1 item left"
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
the todo "Buy groceries" should be marked as completed
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as incomplete
the todo "Buy groceries" should not be marked as completed
the todo count should show "3 items left"

elements.name: Mark all todos as complete using toggle all

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I click the toggle all button
I should see 3 completed todos
the todo count should show "0 items left"

elements.name: Toggle all todos back to active

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I click the toggle all button
I should see 3 completed todos
I click the toggle all button
I should see 0 completed todos
the todo count should show "3 items left"

name: Todo Completion Management

description:
As a user
  I want to create and manage todo items
  So that I can keep track of my tasks

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I create a todo with text "Buy groceries"
I should see the todo "Buy groceries" in the list
the todo count should show "1 item left"
the input field should be empty
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I create a todo with text "Buy groceries"
I create a todo with text "Complete project"
I create a todo with text "Call dentist"
I should see 3 todos in the list
the todo count should show "3 items left"
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I press Enter on an empty todo input
I should see 0 todos in the list
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I create a todo with text "Test @#$% special & characters!"
I should see a todo containing "Test @#$% special"
I should see a todo containing "characters!"

elements.name: Create todo with very long text

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I create a todo with 200 characters
I should see 1 todo in the list
the todo should contain the long text

name: Todo Creation and Management

description:
As a user
  I want to delete todo items
  So that I can remove tasks I no longer need

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I delete the todo "Buy groceries"
I should not see the todo "Buy groceries"
I should see 3 todos in the list
the todo count should show "3 items left"
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I delete the todo "Buy groceries"
I delete the todo "Complete project"
I should see 2 todos in the list
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I click the clear completed button
I should see 2 todos in the list
I should see 0 completed todos
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
the clear completed button should be disabled
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
the clear completed button should be enabled

elements.name: Delete the last todo in the list

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I delete all todos one by one
I should see 0 todos in the list
the footer should not be visible

name: Todo Deletion Functionality

description:
As a user
  I want to see drag handles on todo items
  So that I know I can reorder my tasks

elements.name: Verify drag handles are visible on all todos

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
each todo should have a visible drag handle
the drag handle should have the correct accessibility attributes
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
the drag handle should display the hamburger icon
the drag handle should have grab cursor styling

elements.name: Verify todos maintain order when created

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
the todo at position 1 should be "First task"
the todo at position 2 should be "Second task"
the todo at position 3 should be "Third task"
the todo at position 4 should be "Fourth task"
the todo at position 5 should be "Fifth task"

elements.name: Verify all todos have consistent drag handle placement

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
all todos should have drag handles in the same position
drag handles should be left-aligned in each todo item
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
the drag handle should have grab cursor styling
the drag handle should remain visible

elements.name: Verify completed todos have drag handles

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
I mark the todo "Second task" as complete
the completed todo should still have a visible drag handle
the drag handle functionality should remain available

elements.name: Verify todo count persists with drag handles present

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
I should see 5 todos in the list
the todo count should show "5 items left"
each todo should have its drag handle

elements.name: Verify drag handles do not interfere with other todo actions

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos in order:
I hover over a todo
I should see both the drag handle and delete button
I should be able to click the checkbox
I should be able to click the delete button

name: Todo Drag and Drop Re-ordering UI Elements

description:
As a user
  I want to filter todos by their status
  So that I can focus on specific tasks

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I click on the "All" filter
I should see 5 todos in the list
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I click on the "Active" filter
I should see 3 visible todos
the todo count should show "3 items left"
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I click on the "Completed" filter
I should see 2 visible todos
I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I click on the "Active" filter
I click on the "All" filter
I should see 5 todos in the list

elements.name: Active filter shows newly created todo

steps.name: I navigate to the TodoMVC application
I clear all existing todos
I have the following todos:
I mark the todo "Buy groceries" as complete
I mark the todo "Complete project" as complete
I click on the "Active" filter
I create a todo with text "New task"
the todo count should show "4 items left"

name: Todo Filtering Functionality
